events.headline: US THREATENS SANCTIONS OVER PAYMENTS TO IRAN FOR HORMUZ PASSAGE
events.detail: The US Office of Foreign Assets Control has warned that companies paying Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz could face sanctions Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: JAPAN PM: HORMUZ CLOSURE ‘INFLICTING ENORMOUS IMPACT’ ON ASIA PACIFIC
events.detail: Japan’s PM says the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz is ‘inflicting an ‘enormous impact’ on Asia Pacific.

events.headline: IRAN WARNS US TO STAY OUT OF HORMUZ AFTER TRUMP SAYS US WILL ‘GUIDE’ SHIPS
events.detail: President Trump said the US will begin Project Freedom on Monday to guide stranded ships out of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: TWO CARGO VESSELS STRUCK NEAR STRAIT OF HORMUZ – MONITOR
events.detail: A bulk carrier and a tanker have been attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, the UKMTO monitoring organization said Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TRUMP SAYS US TO BEGIN ‘GUIDING’ SHIPS IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: US President Donald Trump has announced a naval mission to 'guide' stranded ships through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: OIL PRICES FLAT AS TRUMP’S PLAN FOR STRAIT OF HORMUZ FAILS TO CALM MARKET
events.detail: Brent crude is largely unmoved by Trump's announcement of the operation, dubbed 'Project Freedom'.
